source.title: Dynamite explosion in the mountain
source.author: Felix Blume
source.downloadKind: public HQ MP3 preview; original WAV master not downloaded
source.description: Field recording of dynamite breaking a rock near Chacaltaya, Bolivia, February 2014. Not a recording of a specific game weapon.

derivative.processing: FFmpeg highpass 28Hz, lowpass 6500Hz, mono/resample; remove DC; normalize peak0.72; 3ms attack/400ms tail fade; no generated layers

runtime.processing: Linear resample, edge fades and existing distance/EQ/echo processing; prepared before play; no live fetch/decode
